Package io.micronaut.context.watch

@NullMarked package io.micronaut.context.watch
Watches over the bean definitions, beans, executable methods, configuration, resources and classes of a context: a watcher describes what it derives state from with a fluent request, such as DefinitionWatchRequest, and receives one batch whenever it changes, the state when the watch was registered being the first batch, or one change at a time through the per-change handlers of the request.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
graemerocher

    Description
    BeanDefinitionChange<T>
    One batch of changes to the bean definitions a watch selects: what went, what came, the set after the batch, and which removed definitions came back as a new generation of the same bean.
    BeanDefinitionChange.Replacement<T>
    A removed definition and the added one that replaces it.
    BeanDefinitionWatcher<T>
    Receives the batches of a definition watch, registered with DefinitionWatchRequest.watch(BeanDefinitionWatcher).
    BeanExecutableMethod<A extends Annotation>
    An executable method of a bean, as a method watch delivers it: the definition of the bean the method is invoked on, and the method.
    BeanInstanceChange<T>
    One batch of changes to the bean instances a watch selects: the registrations added, the ones removed, the set after the batch, and which removed ones came back as a new generation of the same bean.
    BeanInstanceChange.Replacement<T>
    A removed bean and the added one that replaces it: the bean of the same definition class and qualifier in the new generation.
    BeanInstanceWatcher<T>
    Receives the batches of an instance watch, registered with InstanceWatchRequest.watch(BeanInstanceWatcher).
    BeanWatch
    A registered watch, closed by whoever registered it, or for it when the bean that registered it while being created is destroyed.
    ClassChangeWatcher
    Receives the class changes of a development reload, registered with ClassChangeWatchRequest.watch(ClassChangeWatcher): the watch for a cache keyed by class, which forgets what it holds of a retired generation with ClassChangeEvent.isStaleType(Class).
    ClassChangeWatchRequest
    A request to watch the class changes of a development reload, started with WatchableBeanContext.classChanges(), and completed by ClassChangeWatchRequest.watch(ClassChangeWatcher): the watch for a cache keyed by class, which evicts what ClassChangeEvent.isStaleType(Class) says belongs to a retired generation, or for state derived from classes rather than from beans.
    ConfigurationChange
    One batch of configuration changes, as a refresh computed it, or the first batch of a watch that asked for one, which describes the configuration as it is rather than a change.
    ConfigurationWatcher
    Receives the configuration changes a ConfigurationWatchRequest selects, after the configuration beans they concern were bound again, and applies them to what the watcher derived from the configuration.
    ConfigurationWatchRequest
    A request to watch the configuration, all of it or under a prefix, started with WatchableBeanContext.configuration() or WatchableBeanContext.configuration(String), and completed by ConfigurationWatchRequest.watch(ConfigurationWatcher) or ConfigurationWatchRequest.watchReloading(ReloadingConfigurationWatcher).
    DefinitionWatchRequest<T>
    A request to watch the bean definitions of a type, started with WatchableBeanContext.definitions(io.micronaut.core.type.Argument): it selects the definitions, and is completed by one of its terminal operations, which choose what is watched of them.
    ExecutableMethodChange<A extends Annotation>
    One batch of changes to the executable methods carrying an annotation: what went, what came, the set after the batch, and which removed methods came back as a new generation of the same method.
    ExecutableMethodChange.Replacement<A extends Annotation>
    A removed method and the added one that replaces it.
    ExecutableMethodWatcher<A extends Annotation>
    Receives the batches of a method watch, registered with MethodWatchRequest.watch(ExecutableMethodWatcher).
    InstanceWatchRequest<T>
    A request to watch the beans of the definitions a DefinitionWatchRequest selected, continued with DefinitionWatchRequest.instances(), and completed by InstanceWatchRequest.watch(BeanInstanceWatcher) or InstanceWatchRequest.watch().
    MethodWatchRequest<A extends Annotation>
    A request to watch the executable methods carrying an annotation, directly or as a stereotype: those of every bean, started with WatchableBeanContext.methods(Class), or those of the definitions a DefinitionWatchRequest selected, continued with DefinitionWatchRequest.methods(Class).
    ReloadingConfigurationWatcher
    Receives the configuration changes a ConfigurationWatchRequest selects, registered with ConfigurationWatchRequest.watchReloading(ReloadingConfigurationWatcher), and says what it did about each: the form for a watcher that cannot always apply a change in place, such as one whose bean must be created again, or a server whose port changed, which a development launcher restarts.
    ReloadingConfigurationWatcher.Outcome
    What a watcher did with a change.
    ResourceChange
    One batch of changes to the resources of a kind.
    ResourceSelector
    What a resource watch selects: a kind of resource root and globs relative to it, such as of(VIEWS, "**&#47;*.html").
    ResourceWatcher
    Receives the batches of a resource watch, registered with ResourceWatchRequest.watch(ResourceWatcher).
    ResourceWatchRequest
    A request to watch the resources of a kind of resource root, started with WatchableBeanContext.resources(io.micronaut.context.reload.ResourceKind), and completed by ResourceWatchRequest.watch(ResourceWatcher).
